question: Who brought the printing press for the first time to India in the mid-16th century?
solution:
The correct option is __**Portuguese Missionaries**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Portuguese missionaries brought the printing press in Goa in the mid 16th century**__.
 
• **Portuguese priests learned Konkani** and printed several tracts.
 
• By 1674, they printed around 50 books in the **Konkani and Kanara languages**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Some of the books which were printed includes ***Conclusoes e outras coisas, Confecionarios, and Doutrina Christa**.*
 
• **Johannes Gutenberg**** invented the printing press** in the **15th century in Europe**.
